result.instructions: Tools for Feegow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments does Dr. Silva have tomorrow, and which are not yet confirmed?"; "Find the next free slots for a dermatology consultation this week."; "Book patient 6563 with professional 10 on 2026-11-03 at 15:00.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Feegow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run feegow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run feegow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run feegow_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. feegow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: feegow_list_units
tools.title: List units (branches)
tools.description: The clinic's main unit (matriz, unidade_id 0) and its branches, with trade name, CNPJ, address and contacts. Use the unit ids to filter other tools. GET /company/list-unity.

tools.name: feegow_list_locations
tools.title: List locations (rooms)
tools.description: Rooms/locations registered in each unit (id, name, unidade_id). The location id is needed to create appointments. GET /company/list-local.

tools.name: feegow_list_specialties
tools.title: List specialties
tools.description: Medical specialties offered, with their default consultation procedure ids and whether they show in online booking. GET /specialties/list.

unit_id.description: Unit (branch) id. 0 = the main clinic (matriz). Omit for all units where the endpoint allows it. See feegow_list_units.

tools.name: feegow_list_professionals
tools.title: List professionals
tools.description: Doctors and other professionals (names and ids), active or inactive, optionally by unit or specialty. GET /professional/list.

unit_id.description: Unit (branch) id. 0 = the main clinic (matriz). Omit for all units where the endpoint allows it. See feegow_list_units.

specialty_id.description: Only professionals of this specialty (see feegow_list_specialties).

tools.name: feegow_get_professional
tools.title: Get professional
tools.description: One professional's details and specialties. GET /professional/search.

tools.name: feegow_list_professional_insurances
tools.title: List insurances a professional accepts
tools.description: Health insurances (convênios) accepted by one professional. GET /professional/insurance.

tools.name: feegow_list_insurances
tools.title: List insurances (convênios)
tools.description: All accepted health insurances with their plans. GET /insurance/list.

unit_id.description: Unit (branch) id. 0 = the main clinic (matriz). Omit for all units where the endpoint allows it. See feegow_list_units.

tools.name: feegow_list_procedure_types
tools.title: List procedure types
tools.description: Procedure types (consultation, exam, surgery, return...) and their ids, used by feegow_list_procedures. GET /procedures/types.

tools.name: feegow_list_procedures
tools.title: List procedures
tools.description: Procedures (consultations, exams...) with price IN CENTS (R$ 12.00 = 1200), duration and online-booking flag. Give a procedure type (see feegow_list_procedure_types) or one procedure id; optionally narrow by name, unit, specialty, professional, patient or price table. GET /procedures/list.

procedure_id.description: One procedure id (use when no type is given).

unit_id.description: Unit (branch) id. 0 = the main clinic (matriz). Omit for all units where the endpoint allows it. See feegow_list_units.

patient_id.description: Prices for this patient (their price table / insurance).

tools.name: feegow_list_appointment_statuses
tools.title: List appointment statuses
tools.description: Appointment status ids and names (booked, confirmed, in service, attended, no-show, cancelled...), used to filter and update appointments. GET /appoints/status.

tools.name: feegow_list_appointment_reasons
tools.title: List cancel/reschedule reasons
tools.description: Reasons (motivos) that cancel or reschedule an appointment can carry; the id is required by feegow_cancel_appointment and feegow_reschedule_appointment. GET /appoints/motives.

tools.name: feegow_list_booking_channels
tools.title: List booking channels
tools.description: Channels an appointment can be booked through (online booking, clinic...). GET /appoints/list-channel.

tools.name: feegow_list_patient_sources
tools.title: List patient sources
tools.description: Patient acquisition sources (origens) and their ids, used when creating a patient. GET /patient/list-sources.

tools.name: feegow_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: Appointments in a date range (or one appointment by id), filtered by professional, patient, unit, location, specialty, channel, procedure or status. Paged: pass the previous reply's next_start. Health data: contains patient ids. GET /appoints/search.

appointment_id.description: One appointment id; then the dates are optional.

date_from.description: First day, yyyy-mm-dd. Required unless appointment_id is given.

date_to.description: Last day, yyyy-mm-dd. Required unless appointment_id is given.

unit_id.description: Unit (branch) id. 0 = the main clinic (matriz). Omit for all units where the endpoint allows it. See feegow_list_units.

status_ids.description: Only these statuses (feegow_list_appointment_statuses), e.g. [1, 7] for booked.

start.description: Position of the first row (default 0). Use next_start from the previous reply.

tools.name: feegow_get_available_schedule
tools.title: Find open appointment slots
tools.description: Free appointment times for a specialty or a procedure between two dates, optionally for one professional, unit or insurance. Use before feegow_create_appointment. GET /appoints/available-schedule.

kind.description: What to search by: a specialty or a procedure.

unit_id.description: Unit (branch) id. 0 = the main clinic (matriz). Omit for all units where the endpoint allows it. See feegow_list_units.

tools.name: feegow_list_patients
tools.title: List patients
tools.description: Registered patients, filtered by phone, CPF, source, birthday (dd-mm) or last-changed date. Health data (LGPD): returns names, contacts and CPF. Paged: pass the previous reply's next_offset. GET /patient/list.

changed_since.description: Only patients changed on this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

include_health_program.description: true = include each patient's health program.

tools.name: feegow_get_patient
tools.title: Get patient
tools.description: One patient by id or CPF: name, birth date, contacts, address, insurance. Health data (LGPD). Feegow caches reads for 5 minutes; set fresh=true right after an edit. GET /patient/search.

cpf.description: CPF, digits only (used when no patient_id).

include_photo_url.description: true = include the patient photo URL.

tools.name: feegow_list_patient_dependents
tools.title: List patient dependents
tools.description: Dependents registered under one patient. Health data (LGPD). GET /patient/list-dependents.

tools.name: feegow_list_proposals
tools.title: List proposals (quotes)
tools.description: Treatment/procedure proposals with values in REAIS (R$): for one patient, and/or created (or last changed) in a date range. Give patient_id, or both dates. GET /proposal/list.

date_kind.description: Which date the range filters: created (default) or last changed.

tools.name: feegow_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices (receivables and payables)
tools.description: Financial invoices (contas) in a date range: receivables (C) or payables (D), with value, description, payer/payee, invoice number and payment details. Optionally one unit, invoice or appointment. Financial data. GET /financial/list-invoice.

direction.description: receivable = contas a receber (C), payable = contas a pagar (D).

unit_id.description: Unit (branch) id. 0 = the main clinic (matriz). Omit for all units where the endpoint allows it. See feegow_list_units.

tools.name: feegow_create_appointment
tools.title: Create appointment
tools.description: WRITE: books a new appointment in the clinic's agenda (not in the past). Check feegow_get_available_schedule first; a taken slot or unknown patient is refused. Feegow may notify the patient (SMS/e-mail/WhatsApp) according to the clinic's own automation settings. valor is in CENTS and must be 0 with insurance. POST /appoints/new-appoint.

time.description: Time of day, 24 h, HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

value_cents.description: Price in CENTS (e.g. R$ 550.00 = 55000). Must be 0 when using insurance.

insurance_id.description: Insurance (convênio) id: set it, with insurance_plan_id, to book under insurance.

insurance_plan_id.description: Plan id of the insurance. Required with insurance_id.

tools.name: feegow_reschedule_appointment
tools.title: Reschedule appointment
tools.description: WRITE: moves an existing appointment to a new date and time (the old slot is released). A reason id is required (feegow_list_appointment_reasons). Feegow may notify the patient according to the clinic's settings. POST /appoints/reschedule.

tools.name: feegow_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel appointment
tools.description: WRITE: cancels an existing appointment (it cannot be restored through the API; book a new one instead). A reason id is required (feegow_list_appointment_reasons). Feegow may notify the patient according to the clinic's settings. POST /appoints/cancel-appoint.

tools.name: feegow_update_appointment_status
tools.title: Update appointment status
tools.description: WRITE: sets an appointment's status (for example confirmed, waiting, attended, no-show) and adds a note to the agenda. Status ids: feegow_list_appointment_statuses. To cancel or move an appointment use the cancel/reschedule tools. POST /appoints/statusUpdate.

notes.description: Note added to the agenda entry.

arrival_time.description: Arrival time shown in the waiting room (only for the waiting status), HH:MM.

tools.name: feegow_create_patient
tools.title: Create patient
tools.description: WRITE: registers a new patient and returns the patient_id. Feegow does not duplicate: when a patient with the same CPF and birth date (or, without a CPF, the same name plus mobile, e-mail or birth date) exists, that patient's id is returned and nothing is created. Set no_cpf=true for a patient without CPF. Health data (LGPD): only register data the patient gave the clinic. POST /patient/create.

no_cpf.description: true = the patient has no CPF (then cpf is ignored).

tools.name: feegow_update_patient
tools.title: Update patient
tools.description: WRITE: changes a patient's registration data. Only the fields you pass are sent; they overwrite stored values. CPF can only be set when absent, never replaced after registration (vendor rejects a different existing CPF). Health data (LGPD). Feegow caches reads for 5 minutes (use fresh=true in feegow_get_patient to see the change). POST /patient/edit.
